The '''Northwind Guard'''<ref>[[Old Hamilton#Quotes]]</ref> is the military that guards [[Northwind]]. The [[Northwind Guard (NPC)|Northwind Guards]] are led by [[Sir Amberwood|Sir Nathaniel Amberwood]], elder brother to [[Lord Amberwood|Lord Percival Amberwood]], ruler of Northwind.

Due to machinations from Lady [[Katrana Prestor]] and Sir Amberwood, what little forces the Northwind Guard had left were allocated to the western parts of Northwind, leaving the east vulnerable to invasion by the [[Dark Horde]] and the [[Dark Iron clan]]. Locations such as [[Lion's Watch]], which watched over the [[Merchant's Highroad]], were left maintained only by local militia,<ref>[[Guard Ellington#Quotes]]</ref> whereas [[Northridge Point]] and [[Ruins of Birkhaven|Birkhaven]] fell to the [[Blackrock clan]]. The weakened military presence allowed for members of the [[Defias Brotherhood]] to infiltrate Northwind and for members of the [[Stormreaver clan]] to kidnap the inhabitants of the region.
